message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src/wav.c", "function": "wav_read_header", "line": 719, "var": "format", "code": "case WAVE_FORMAT_IMA_ADPCM :", "note": "WAV header declares WAVE_FORMAT_IMA_ADPCM (0x11), selecting the IMA ADPCM decoder path.", "role": "source", "phase": "format"},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src/wav.c", "function": "wav_read_header", "line": 721, "var": "blockalign", "code": "*blockalign = wav_fmt->ima.blockalign ;", "note": "blockalign=5 read from the fmt chunk; this is the attacker-controlled block size.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/wav.c", "function": "wav_read_header", "line": 722, "var": "framesperblock", "code": "*framesperblock = wav_fmt->ima.samplesperblock ;", "note": "samplesperblock=3 read from the fmt chunk; passes the equality check count=2*(5-4)/1+1=3 in ima_reader_init.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/ima_adpcm.c", "function": "ima_reader_init", "line": 178, "var": "pimasize", "code": "pimasize = sizeof (IMA_ADPCM_PRIVATE) + blockalign * psf->sf.channels + 3 * psf->sf.channels * samplesperblock ;", "note": "Allocates samples buffer sized samplesperblock*channels = 3 shorts; block buffer sized blockalign=5 bytes.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/ima_adpcm.c", "function": "ima_reader_init", "line": 228, "var": "pima->decode_block", "code": "pima->decode_block = wavlike_ima_decode_block ;", "note": "WAV container selects wavlike_ima_decode_block as the decode function.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/ima_adpcm.c", "function": "ima_reader_init", "line": 247, "var": "pima->decode_block", "code": "pima->decode_block (psf, pima) ;", "note": "First block is decoded immediately during reader init, entering wavlike_ima_decode_block.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/ima_adpcm.c", "function": "wavlike_ima_decode_block", "line": 424, "var": "blockindx", "code": "blockindx = 4 * pima->channels ;", "note": "blockindx starts at 4 (4*channels=4), skipping the 4-byte block header.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/ima_adpcm.c", "function": "wavlike_ima_decode_block", "line": 427, "var": "blockindx", "code": "while (blockindx < pima->blocksize)", "note": "Loop iterates while blockindx(4) < blocksize(5); one outer iteration runs even though only 1 data byte remains (blocksize-4*channels=1 not divisible by 4*channels=4).", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/ima_adpcm.c", "function": "wavlike_ima_decode_block", "line": 434, "var": "pima->samples[indx]", "code": "pima->samples [indx] = (bytecode >> 4) & 0x0F ;", "note": "Unpack loop writes 8*channels=8 samples per outer iteration regardless of remaining bytes; with only 1 data byte the loop writes indx up to 8, exceeding the 3-short samples buffer, causing heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 2.", "role": "root", "invariant": "decoded sample index must not exceed samplesperblock*channels buffer capacity", "captures": {"indx": "(long)indx", "capacity": "(long)(pima->samplesperblock * pima->channels)"}, "condition": {"op": "ge", "left": "indx", "right": "capacity"}}
]
EOF
echo "trace written"; python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid json')"` executed with exit code 0.
